content: Hi! #38310 (about 150 lines, follow-up to #36320 which was merged last month) has been open for a week with no reviewer assigned yet. It adds word evaluation and reachability characterization for Schreier graphs, built directly on the definitions in #36320. All checks are green. @Antoine Chambert-Loir , would you be open to taking another look since you have context from the predecessor? Otherwise, anyone familiar with quivers or group actions is welcome. Thanks!
